response.description: An information content entity that consists of a CRID symbol and additional information about the CRID registry to which it belongs.
response.label: centrally registered identifier

response.description: An identifier that denotes some postal delivery route, some aggregate of postal delivery routes or a geographical region and was created for the purpose of sorting and delivering mail.
response.label: postal code

response.description: An identifier referring to an individual entity that is ascribed personhood by the user of the identifier.
response.label: personal name

response.description: An identifier that is typically a part of a person's name which has been passed, according to law or custom, from one or both parents to their children.
response.label: family name
